text: with a grin that indicated what she meant just might be a sin. Your hands are cold, let me warm them a while. She lifted up her dress as she slept. Oh, no, you're not, she said. Take me by my innocent hand and walk me to the road. Take me to the place that I love, the place that I want to go. Here we go.
